name: Polaris Group
summary: Polaris Group, together with its subsidiaries, offers biotechnology, drug testing, and contract development and manufacturing services. The company engages in the research, development, manufacture and sale of new drugs. It develops ADI-PEG 20 for the treatment of various cancer indications, as well as provides healthcare consulting, staffing, and MDS solutions. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Grand Cayman, Grand Cayman.
